Update `isValidConfig()` in types.ts to validate the new boolean field (when review is present, postTask must be a boolean). Update `loadConfig()` in config.ts to default `postTask: false` alongside the existing maxIterations default. Add `reviewPostTask: boolean` to `ConfigDefaults` in init.ts with default `false`, and prompt for it in `promptForConfig()` after the existing review maxIterations prompt. tasks.title: Git SHA helpers
tasks.description:
TDD. Create `src/post-task-reviewer.ts` with two functions:

1. `captureGitSha(projectRoot: string): string | null` — runs `git rev-parse HEAD` via `child_process.execSync` with `{ cwd: projectRoot }`, returns the trimmed SHA string, or null if the command fails (not a git repo, etc.).

2. `getGitDiff(projectRoot: string, beforeSha: string): { diff: string; log: string; files: string[] }` — runs three git commands with `{ cwd: projectRoot }`:
   - `git diff <beforeSha>..HEAD` → diff string
   - `git log --oneline <beforeSha>..HEAD` → log string
   - `git diff --name-only <beforeSha>..HEAD` → split into files array (filter empty lines)

Create `test/post-task-reviewer.test.ts`. Tests should create a real temp git repo (mkdtemp), run `git init`, make commits, and verify:
- captureGitSha returns a valid 40-char hex SHA
- captureGitSha returns null for a non-git directory
- getGitDiff returns correct diff/log/files after adding a file and committing

tasks.title: Post-task review prompt builders
tasks.description:
TDD. Add two pure functions to `src/post-task-reviewer.ts`:

1. `buildPostTaskReviewPrompt(): string` — returns the system prompt that instructs the reviewer agent to:
   - Build an ASCII coverage diagram comparing task spec items vs actual changes using `[DONE]`, `[GAP]`, `[PARTIAL]` markers with tree-drawing characters
   - Detect gaps (anything in task description not addressed)
   - Check for regressions (broken patterns, removed exports, deleted tests)
   - Append output to `.ralph/review-post.md` using Edit tool (or Write if file doesn't exist yet)
   - Use the exact output format from planning-notes.md: `## Task #<id>: <title>`, `Reviewed: <ISO timestamp>`, Coverage tree, Files Changed, Gaps, Regression Risks, Verdict (CLEAN | HAS_GAPS | HAS_RISKS)

2. `buildPostTaskReviewUserPrompt(opts: { task: { id: number; title: string; description: string; files?: string[]; tests?: string[]; directory?: string }; diff: string; log: string; files: string[] }): string` — returns the user prompt embedding the full task definition and git diff/log/files.

Tests verify: system prompt contains format spec keywords (DONE, GAP, PARTIAL, review-post.md, Edit), user prompt contains task fields and diff content.

tasks.title: Post-task reviewer spawner
Review orchestrator
Wire into run loop
tasks.description:
TDD. Integrate post-task review into `src/commands/run.ts`.

1. **Add deps to RunRunDeps** (around line 272): Add `captureGitSha: (projectRoot: string) => string | null` and `runPostTaskReview: (opts: RunPostTaskReviewOpts) => Promise<void>`. Import the types and default implementations from `src/post-task-reviewer.ts`.

2. **Capture SHA before agent spawn** (~line 533, before `deps.spawnClaude()`): `const beforeSha = deps.captureGitSha(projectRoot);`

3. **Call review after test validation** (~line 563, after validateTaskTests, before archiveCompletedTasks ~line 565): Re-read the task from tasks.json to get its current status. If status is 'complete', call:
```ts
await deps.runPostTaskReview({
  projectRoot,
  dataDir,
  task: currentTask,
  taskStatus: updatedTask.status,
  beforeSha,
  config,
  streamOpts,
});
```

4. **Set defaults in createDefaultDeps()**: Import `captureGitSha` and `runPostTaskReview` from post-task-reviewer and wire them as defaults.

Tests in `test/commands/run.test.ts`:
- SHA is captured before spawnClaude is called
- runPostTaskReview is called after validation when task is complete
- runPostTaskReview is NOT called when review.postTask is false/undefined
- runPostTaskReview is NOT called when task status is not complete
